title: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: 龙井(Longjing)是一种绿茶，主要产自中国东部沿海的浙江省。龙井茶独特的香味和口感为其赢得了"中国名茶"的称号，在中国深受大众的欢迎,在海外饮用的人也越来越多。龙井茶通常手工制作，其价格可能极其昂贵,也可能比较便宜，这取决于茶的生长地、采摘时间和制作工艺。龙井茶富含维生素C和其他多种有益健康的元素。经常喝龙井茶有助于减轻疲劳、延缓衰老。
reference: Longjing is a kind of green tea produced mainly in Zhejiang Province on the eastern coast of China. Its unique aroma and taste have earned Longjing the title of "China Famous Tea", and it is very popular among the public in China, with an increasing number of people drinking it abroad as well. Longjing tea is usually made by hand, and its price can be extremely high or relatively low, depending on where it grows, when it is picked, and how it is made. In addition, Longjing tea is rich in vitamin C and various other elements beneficial to health. Drinking it regularly helps relieve fatigue and delay aging.
